description: JH-08 is the District Transport Office (DTO) for Lohardaga, Jharkhand, operating under the Transport Department of the Government of Jharkhand. It manages all transport-related activities including vehicle registration, issuance of driving permits, and road tax collection for the Lohardaga district. The office serves as a primary regulatory body ensuring vehicle compliance and safety in the region.
address: District Transport Office, Collectorate Building, Lohardaga, Jharkhand
